text:
Ana: Quick sync — planning gated webinar for the refapp mini-series. Need a clear lead-flow mapping: registration form -> HubSpot -> routing rules -> followups. Sketching requirements here, please add gaps.

Mike: short Q — do we gate slides and the demo recording? my vote: gate both. also need UTM scheme and the registration CTA copy.

Priya: Agree on gating. Suggest minimal form fields to reduce friction: email + company + use_case dropdown. Capture hidden utm_source/utm_medium/utm_campaign fields.

Devon: For lead scoring: +2 for OSS maintainers, +3 for infra/platform roles, +1 for attendees from partner channels. Score threshold 4 -> handoff to sales queue.

Sara: HubSpot form mapping (proposal):
```json
{
  "email": "email",
  "firstname": "first_name",
  "company": "company",
  "use_case": "custom_field_use_case",
  "utm_source": "utm_source",
  "utm_campaign": "utm_campaign"
}
```

Marcos: On webhook side, we'll emit a standard payload when someone registers. Fields: event_type=webinar_reg, product=refapp, campaign=devcontent_gated, utm_* and ts. Backend consumer can filter on event_type.

webhook-bot: POST /webhooks/lead (sample payload)
```http
POST https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing/lead
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email":"anna@example.com",
  "event":"webinar_reg",
  "product":"refapp",
  "campaign":"devcontent_gated",
  "utm_source":"twitter",
  "ts":1876543211
}
```

Ana: Downstream routing plan: HubSpot -> Slack #sales-leads for score>=4 (instant alert); HubSpot workflows -> Salesforce sync for enterprise flags (company_size>250 or ARR_estimate>10k); growth-review gets daily digest of registrants grouped by channel.

Mike: Who owns the landing page and form build? can design + dev deliver by Tue? tagging @Design for assets.

Priya: I'll own the landing page build and form integration. Need hero assets + a 1-slide demo GIF. Timeline looks ok; will coordinate with design.

Devon: Quick QA checklist before go-live: confirm double opt-in, test webhook with 500/200/500 responses, confirm GA & GA4 event firing, verify UTM canonicalization, and end-to-end HubSpot->Salesforce mapping test.

Sara: I'll draft the confirmation email copy and the registration thank-you page (with calendar add & short link to privacy). Will post the first draft by EOD today.

Ana: Great — plan an end-to-end dry run Thurs 10:00am. I'll send invites to growth, sales engineering, infra so we can test webhook consumers and the landing flow. :calendar:
